correctness.rationale: Reassessed the complete corrected RESULT.md in /workspace/repairs/5. Correctness of the original mathematical counts was not the issue. Forth and back are equivalent to requiring that the image of each inclusive descendant cone be the suffix starting at its vertex's image. A leaf must go to top. With two worlds, bottom-root maps choose child maps independently; with three worlds, bottom-root child assignments exclude precisely the all-top assignment, since any child image containing bottom must contain middle. The corrected statement and proof preserve the non-onto scope, recurrences, path counts and star minimum. I separately enumerated every rooted shape through order seven by increasing-parent labellings (every shape has such a labelling), deduplicated via sorted balanced parentheses, and enumerated every vertex function using explicit descendant and value masks. The independent replay is `python3 /workspace/repairs/5/check_cutoffs.py`. It gave shape counts 1,1,2,4,9,20,48 and separate maxima (1,1),(2,2),(3,4),(4,7),(5,11),(7,16),(10,25); it checked the two unique maximizing shapes at orders six and seven. At order five the path can tie, consistent with 'maximizes'. The two-world witness count c goes to 2c−1 as the order goes up by two; bases 7>6 and 9>7 suffice. The three-world count at least triples as the order increases by three; bases 25>22, 40>29 and 65>37 and the strictly positive difference 3p(n)−p(n+3)=n²−4n−1 for p(n)=1+binom(n,2) prove all later cases. These analytic arguments, not execution on larger trees, prove the unbounded witness statements. The frozen checker and its saved output were inspected, not executed. The added finite checker was executed as independent corroboration.
